summary.text: John Tomko is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Roth McElvain.
He described himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a hemodialysis CNA and hospital chaplain who lives in Hannibal.

paragraphs.text: Tomko attended Palm Springs Charter Homeschool for high school and John Wood Community College, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2026 survey, he said he is a hemodialysis CNA and hospital chaplain with Foursquare Chaplains International, that he received Chaplain of the Year 2017 from Hannibal Regional Healthcare System, and that he has provided in-home and travel hemodialysis therapy with DaVita Dialysis since 2019.
Tomko named health care, tax reform, and education as his key messages in the survey.

On health care, he proposed raising the MO HealthNet income cap for seniors and adults from $1,600 to $2,600 per month; on taxes, he proposed eliminating the personal property tax; and on education, he proposed updating the funding formula to provide 30 percent raises for K-12 teachers.
